items.item: `Sources/MCP Server/MCP.Server.swift`: `versions` relies on being ordered newest first for the fa
items.reason: Smallest fix instead of a new non-empty ordered collection type: the fallback is the greatest version by rawValue (MCP versions are YYYY-MM-DD dates), and an empty list answers initialize with JSON-RPC internalError (-32603) instead of trapping at versions[0].

notes: Separate from this issue: swift-json#15 (group H, branch backlog/swift-json) makes JSON.serialize() throwing; MCP.Server.line (Sources/MCP Server/MCP.Server.swift, `JSON(response.value).serialize()`) and Sources/MCP Server/MCP.Tool.Call.Result.swift:8 will need `try` once that lands. Left untouched here so this branch builds against current swift-json main.
